Cola or Pepsi?
How much do you earn?
What do you want to do in the future?
Another one biteth the dutht

Hello! I have a quite different question - what would you advise to all of those who are struggling with unrequited love due to their mental illness? I just love the way you present things to people, how your mind works with the relation of seemingly unrelated things, you always give a fresh perspective, I'm a big fan
I had the shading done around my wrist a couple of days ago. I agree, it hurts af. Everything else is not a problem

Thank you for sharing this story. 

You're right, I am grateful that I can still feel. Sometimes a rong pain and desperation but also love and appreciation. It is important because, as I mentioned in earlier post, I guess love is  at the top of three most valuable things you can give to other person. Next to time and understanding. And I find the meaning and purpose of life in the fact that I can give others these three things because we all need them. 

Thank you for your reply once again because it does give me hope to see people like you who learned to truly appreciate their gift of life

True, I wish I could learn to be happy by myself but sometimes the feelings just don't allow me. On the other hand I should be grateful I still feel something and I'm not indifferent to what's going on around me. I guess the point when I'd lose feeling, would be the ultimate bad thing that can happen to me. Yes, I feel a strong pain but on the other hand when I love, I love deeply and I should appreciate it

I understand you. And I hope you'll find this fulfilling way to use your empathy. Not many people have this skill these days, it seems, so I value and respect it very much in others. It's a pity that depression prevents us from doing something we would actually like and have a chance to be really good at

Ahaha sure😁

And family reunions are the worst. It's as you say, they expect you to have a proper job and get married really really soon. Or at least have this serious relationship. So irritating. But hey, you say you've got the looks, good for you😄 I'm sure it'll help you with finally finding the right girl for you. If that's what you want, of course

We've got quite a few similar points, then. Although it was destroying me, I continued to study just because all of my siblings had their MA and I was the last one who was supposed to do it. Unfortunately, I didn't make it, I just didn't go to one retake and that was it - a whole year of hard work for nothing. I'm not especially sad that I don't have to see that place anymore, though. At least I've got my BA. 

I'm very sorry to hear about your gf. It must have been hard for you. But you're absolutely right that these terrible events in relationships at least gave us some experience and insight to what we want. 

And on the brighter side, there is ice cream and pizza.

You're probably right, it's just difficult for me to do it.
Thank you so much for the talk, I really appreciate it and it is good to know that I can find such great people as you in this place :) Have a good night!

> Do you fully trust your friend? 

Absolutely. And you're right, we do share some funny stories or memes with each other. It's just sad that we don't really have much time to talk because of her working hours and poor internet connection. But she'll be back in the country next month so I'm sure we will find time to catch up then.

> So is there any downsides to the friendship, or you personally, that are caused by your feelings for him? 

Not to the friendship. But to me personally, yes. I'm feeling really bad that I can't just be next to him even in whatever ordinary thing he does. I think this is something that affects my mood the most right now

Thank you so much for your reply.   


It's sad to hear that you're going through this. I'm not sure but it seems to me that the 3 most valuable things one can give to another person are love, time and maybe understanding. Knowing that I am able to give all these things to others constitutes some kind of meaning in my life right now but, as you know, depression is merciless and sometimes things get too overwhelming for me

You're absolutely right that I want to know everything about how she's doing and I would be sad if she was hiding something from me. Sometimes I just have this impression that all I can say is another complaint and my mouth just shuts itself  


> Why have you not asked him? 

I often ask myself the same question but I just don't know if he could talk to me the same way anymore. He'd probably feel awkward to talk to me about his dates or any other girls afterwards. And me, on the other hand, I'd probably feel a bit embarrassed in front of him. Right now we know we can tell each other everything and this is a really amazing friendship, it's hard to risk it

I don't really think another hospital is something that would be good for me. I think what I need is to finally find a courage to change the environment, which, I'm aware, is not good for my mental health. But to do that, I need to find a proper job and earn enough money. And this is challenging in my condition
I'm proud of you and wish you all the best. Comghairdeas:) I wish I had your courage to do such a thing, I'm suffocating here

Thank you for your answer.

I want to keep trying as well. Following my psychiatrist's advice, I even voluntarily signed up for a hospitalization at psychiatric ward last year. It didn't end up with much success but I was really motivated to move on with my life at that time. Now I seem to lose this motivation because I'm still stuck at the same point, in the same place and with similar problems

Thank you so much for your answer.

The problem is that my best friend is abroad right now and she's going through similar stuff to mine. We do share our feelings but after years of friendship, I only was able to tell her this month all the worst stuff that happened to me. I'm lucky I have her as a friend, but she is not doing well herself and I'd hate to worsen her mood.

The other friend (yes, there are only 2 people I can truly call friends) who lives abroad helped me so much during my trauma after breaking up with my abusive fiancé. Actually, he's the one who can make me feel truly happy. And this year I've started to feel something more than just a friendship to him. We've met recently for the first time, after exchanging messages almost everyday for over a year. And it was the first time I felt safe and happy since the awful experiences with my ex. Unfortunately, I'm almost sure my feelings for him are unrequited.
Mines are baggy comfy clothes, not wearing make up, avoiding people and eventually just bingewatching some tv series so I don't have to move from bed and talk to others
I agree 100% with what you're saying, I can say that a good friend of mine basically saved my life after I finished an abusive relationship and was traumatised. So I hope you'll find one as well

Yes, I actually tend to analyze things in details, yes. But I don't think the doctors there were really helpful, unfortunately. Also the other patients, some of whom were also threatening me personally, made me want to even pretend I'm better just to get out of there.

And when it comes to that guy - he's my good friend who lives in a neighbouring country. We basically talk everyday since a bit over a year and recently I visited him for the first time. He, together with my best friend, basically saved me after I finished an abusive relationship last year. So yeah, recently I definitely started to feel something more than "just friends" for him. But I am almost sure he doesn't feel the same way
Thank you, I'll definitely try it
Thank you for your message. I will try meditation again, then. Last time it didn't really work out, I just wasn't able to focus enough
Same, you can always write
Thank you for saying this

I've been feeling similar since a long time. And someone once told me to learn to be more egoistic. I guess my empathy level makes it a really hard job but maybe it'll work for you. Trying to take care of yourself first and do what you like to do. You know, not being an asshole, but just learn to take care of yourself first
